summary: Live Vercel deployment E2E test. Previously ALL DB routes returned FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED; now serverless-safe Mongo cache + /api ensure-DB middleware is working — DB routes return proper JSON. Login, catalog, callback, and provider-ping-503 graceful path all confirmed working. Client login flow succeeds end-to-end (demo01/demo1234 → balance 2000), and /play-game/11539 fails GRACEFULLY with Bengali error + retry button (env-blocked provider IP whitelist). 3 real live-only bugs found: (a) client API base URL has trailing slash causing double-slash URLs and CORS-blocked preflights for catalog & launch, (b) /api/9wicket/health without key returns 200 leaking config, (c) CORS allow-list not enforced on live — evil origin is echoed back with credentials.

critical.issue: Returns 200 with full config (apiBase, hasToken, secretConfigured, callbackUrl, returnUrl) instead of 401. Health key guard is missing/misconfigured on LIVE. Sensitive config leak.

Origin 'https://evil.example.com' is echoed back in access-control-allow-origin with access-control-allow-credentials:true. Allow-list not enforced on LIVE — every origin is trusted. ALLOWED_ORIGINS env on Vercel is likely missing / set to '*' / not read.

minor.issue: provider.providerIcon / providerIconUrl still reference dead igamingapis.com URL. Client-facing image/imageUrl/customImageUrl are correctly emergentagent-hosted (renders fine), but the leftover provider fields could be sanitized.

integration_issues.issue: Client calls 'https://bajiman-server.vercel.app//api/global/client/play-game/11539' and '//api/9wicket/launch' (DOUBLE SLASH). Preflight OPTIONS on that URL misses CORS headers → browser blocks with 'has been blocked by CORS policy'. Root cause: VITE_API_BASE (or equivalent) on the deployed client has a trailing '/'. Login (simple POST, no preflight) still slips through. User-visible impact is masked because the launch error UI treats network-error identically to graceful 503, but the console is full of CORS errors and catalog XHR fails.

action_items: Fix VITE_API_BASE (or REACT_APP_*) on bajiman-client-one Vercel: strip trailing slash so URLs are '.../api/...' not '.../ /api/...'. Alternatively normalize in axios baseURL in client.

Fix Vercel env ALLOWED_ORIGINS for bajiman-server so CORS actually enforces allow-list (evil origin must NOT be echoed). Verify server/index.js CORS reads process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS as comma-separated list and falls back to reject-unknown, not allow-all.
Fix Vercel env HEALTH_KEY (or health-guard middleware) on bajiman-server: /api/9wicket/health?ping=false without ?key/x-health-key must return 401. Right now it returns 200 with sensitive config.
Optional: strip / sanitize provider.providerIcon (igamingapis.com) in catalog response.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware on live behaves as reflect-any-origin — clearly not honoring ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Combined with allow-credentials:true this is a CSRF/credential-theft risk.
Health endpoint exposes apiBase, callbackUrl, hasToken, secretConfigured without auth. Ping-false path bypasses the key check — the guard should run BEFORE branching on ping.
Client bakes API base with trailing slash; every axios request produces //api. Add a runtime guard: axios.defaults.baseURL = (env||'').replace(/\/+$/,'').

success_rate.backend: 80% (8/10 live API assertions passed; 2 real bugs)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (login, balance, image, graceful launch error, mobile+desktop layout all pass; CORS console errors on preflighted XHRs due to double-slash base URL)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED bug is confirmed FIXED — DB routes now return proper JSON. Three live-only issues remain (see action_items). The provider-IP-whitelist 503 is expected/env-blocked until user configures OUTBOUND_PROXY_URL with a static IP; do NOT classify it as a bug. When re-testing after fixes, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_live_vercel.py -v. Note test_catalog_9wicket assertion was intentionally strict on igamingapis substring — it fails on unused providerIcon field; the primary image/imageUrl fields are correct.

rca_of_the_issue.double_slash_cors: Client env var VITE_API_BASE=https://bajiman-server.vercel.app/ (trailing slash). Axios concatenates '/api/...' → '//api/...'. Vercel routes the doubled path but the response (or preflight 404) omits CORS response headers, so the browser blocks preflighted requests. Fix: trim trailing slash in env OR normalize in axios setup.
rca_of_the_issue.cors_allow_any_origin: server/index.js likely uses cors({origin:true}) or reads a missing ALLOWED_ORIGINS env → reflect-request-origin behavior. With credentials:true this is unsafe. Fix: implement whitelist function that returns callback(null,false) for unknown origins and set ALLOWED_ORIGINS env in Vercel.
rca_of_the_issue.health_key_bypass: Guard likely wraps only the ping branch, or reads HEALTH_KEY env that isn't set on Vercel → guard short-circuits to open. Fix: enforce key check at the top of the handler regardless of ping flag; ensure HEALTH_KEY is set in Vercel prod env.
